name: Being Stubborn
overview: Scripture reveals that stubbornness often leads to conflict and divine discipline, as seen in Genesis 16:12 where a wild man opposes others, and Leviticus 26:18 where persistent disobedience results in multiplied punishment. The Lord calls His people to honor and obey authority, especially parents, as emphasized in Exodus 20:12 and Colossians 3:20, highlighting that obedience pleases God. Furthermore, Matthew 12:30 underscores the necessity of aligning with Christ, warning that refusal to do so places one in opposition to Him, illustrating the spiritual consequences of a hardened heart.
